component.text: BioForge recognizes bacteria, viruses, fungi, parasites, prions and the rare universal class. Each class has its own color, default profile and compatible routes.

Pathogen Reagent gives a coarse class test without revealing the hidden genome. Catalyst Vials use ordinary materials for most classes; a universal catalyst is an exceptional Nether Star result rather than a routine ingredient.
Class narrows the problem. A named strain, its mutations and its exact sequence still require proper microscopy and records.
